cardText: Salar de Uyuni: The Salt Mirror · Tier 2 · Adventurer

Flat, open puzzle level: pressure switches raise salt-brick blocks out of brine channels for a window, including a two-switch sequence via a salt-hotel roof; rusted train-car roofs; a climb up Isla Incahuasi. This playable level is still awaiting human visual and device review.
Bolivia is grouped in South America in UN M49. Capital: Sucre.
Launch off a giant bromeliad into the canopy, swing across on vines and ride rafts over the river to a waterfall lookout. This playable level is still awaiting human visual and device review.
Brazil is grouped in South America in UN M49. Capital: Brasília. The Central Amazon Conservation Complex protects forests, lakes and river environments in Brazil.
Angel Falls: The Auyán-tepui Descent · Tier 5 · Master Explorer

Advanced descent from a tepui summit beside Angel Falls: long precise drops, crumbling sandstone, summit gusts and climbable faces between ledges. This playable level is still awaiting human visual and device review.
Venezuela is grouped in South America in UN M49. Capital: Caracas.
Los Glaciares: Perito Moreno Valley · Tier 3 · Challenger

Down a moraine valley in Patagonian gusts, across the lake on drifting ice floes, past the glacier front where warned ice calves, then up slick ice steps. This playable level is still awaiting human visual and device review.
Argentina is grouped in South America in UN M49. Capital: Buenos Aires.
El Tatio: Geysers at Dawn · Tier 4 · Expert Explorer

A high Andean geyser field at dawn: sinter crusts that crack underfoot, lava ledges, steaming terraces and warned geyser jets that must be timed. This playable level is still awaiting human visual and device review.
Chile is grouped in South America in UN M49. Capital: Santiago.
Cocora Valley: Cloud Forest Climb · Tier 4 · Expert Explorer

Vertical cloud-forest climb: mossy climbable cliff faces and wax-palm trunks, a cable crossing basket and crumbling moss ledges in the mist. This playable level is still awaiting human visual and device review.
Colombia is grouped in South America in UN M49. Capital: Bogotá.

Black lava shoreline: warned wave surges over tide-pool rocks, lava-crust ledges that crack and a lava tube, with a higher ridge route. This playable level is still awaiting human visual and device review.
Ecuador is grouped in South America in UN M49. Capital: Quito.
Kaieteur Falls: Potaro Gorge · Tier 2 · Adventurer

Rock shelves in the Potaro River whose current carries the player, then the cliff path beside the falls with spray-wet rock and a rope basket. This playable level is still awaiting human visual and device review.
Guyana is grouped in South America in UN M49. Capital: Georgetown.
